findings.summary: Python basic HTTP preview did not support audio seeking; use standard http-server with byte-range support.

At user request, the backstage recording section explicitly explains offline synthesis on owned hardware, script custody during recording, and no external speech service or cloud API. This claim concerns recording, not GitHub Pages hosting.

unresolved_risks: English script uses English phonemization for non-English presets; not native-language quality proof

closeout.summary: Published54 Sunset-recorded voice auditions with Broadway-inspired gallery, filters, sorting, favorites, queue, lucky selection, original-film history and reproducible installation.
not_claimed: Native-language fluency of world presets reading English
closeout.residual_risk: Browser playback policies vary; voice suitability and pronunciation require listener judgment.
